login.heroTitle: Sign in to continue your analysis.
login.heroBody: All your uploaded documents, chat history, and risk reports — exactly where you left them.
login.formBody: Resume previous uploads, keep your chat history, and continue reviewing legal documents with the same premium workspace.
login.terms: By signing in you agree to our Terms of Service. SmartLegal AI does not store your documents after analysis.

register.title: Start your legal review workspace.
register.body: Save upload history, revisit analysis dashboards, and keep your question threads in one place.
register.terms: By creating an account you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Your documents are never stored permanently.
register.sideTitle: Keep every insight, risk flag, and AI answer in one account.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Enter the email linked to your account and we’ll send you a link to reset your password.
forgot.devBody: No email provider is configured, so here is your reset link for testing:

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your password has been reset and all other sessions were signed out. Redirecting to sign in…
reset.body: Choose a strong new password. This will also sign you out of all other devices.
reset.tokenPlaceholder: Paste the token from your reset email
